fields.ONE_LINER: Automatic fixture cleaner - 20-40 fixtures per basket, 30-40 min cycle, full SUS304 with water-based fluid.
fields.NARRATIVE: A rotating basket takes 20 to 40 fixtures through wash and rinse in a 30 to 40 minute cycle. Three-stage filtration keeps the fluid in service instead of in the drain.
fields.SPEC_01: 01  BASKET                Rotating, 1000 mm diameter x 200 mm high
fields.SPEC_04: 04  TANKS                 80 L wash plus 80 L rinse
fields.SPEC_05: 05  FILTRATION            3-stage, 2 mm to 100 um to 20 um
fields.HERO_MEDIA: SME5200 with the rotating basket loaded, 3/4 view or muted looping MP4
fields.MARQUEE_MEDIA: basket rotation / wash spray / rinse / filtration stack / fixture loading / control panel
